title: Interview: John Lennon for Hit Parader | 1974
content:
John Lennon gave an interview to Hit Parader magazine on 9 September 1974.

The interview took place at the apartment Lennon shared with May Pang, Penthouse Tower B of the Southgate complex at 434 East 52nd Street, Manhattan.

The magazine’s editor Lisa Robinson discussed various subjects with Lennon, including his forthcoming album Walls And Bridges, and plans for a new album in 1975. He also spoke about wanting to appear in more films, and his ongoing and lengthy attempts to obtain permanent residency in the US.
